correctness.rationale: Exact parent-sequence counting gives (i-1)(n-3)! outcomes for every fixed child j, all with equal probability. Deleting i,j creates an independent (n-2)-vertex uniform recursive tree and a uniform earlier attachment, yielding a distribution identity, conditional harmonic mean, covariance and exact finite sign threshold. The independent-parent proof covers all n; finite rational enumeration checked the same identity for n=3,...,9.

originality.rationale: The exact marked-birth-index fringe event and its conditional full path-length distribution retain age information erased by unmarked fringe size counts. Holmgren–Janson Theorems 1.4 and 1.15 do not supply fixed-birth-index mixed moments; primary depth-profile literature does not condition on a small fringe. Available searches and neighboring records disclose no stated equivalent; this is best-knowledge originality, not certified historical uniqueness.

value.rationale: A specified age-index fringe is a natural local marker in a uniform-attachment growth tree; total depth is a standard global cost. Their covariance switches direction at a universal birth fraction, explaining how age-specific effects are lost on summing unmarked motifs. Independence of the full conditioned path-length law from the identity of the single child supplies nontrivial structure beyond an isolated numerical covariance.
